name: The American Dream Team
caption: A two-man tag team, runners-up for the first RSPCW World Tag Team Championship at the fed's debut supercard.

tenures.source: MegaWrestleFest, 10 April 1994 (cage match for the inaugural RSPCW World Tag Team Championship, served on this wing)
tenures.note: Lost the cage match for the inaugural title to an unminted pairing billed "Law and Order".
